bio.title: Bio
bio.subtitle: A verbal summary
content: I am a software engineer who enjoys building maintainable, reliable, and scalable systems.
On the Bing team at Microsoft, I maintained the data ingestion services and APIs for esports-related user experiences.
I also helped pioneer the development of the first React applications on Bing, including a new homepage for tablets.
Previously, I worked on Azure SQL Database, where I built PowerShell commandlets for the managed backup service.
I graduated from Duke University in 2015 with a B.S. in Computer Science.
In my free time I work on various open source projects, including co-founding The OpenDota Project, a service that provides detailed data from the replay files of the ARTS game Dota 2.
It now has over 680,000 registered users and serves over 100 million API requests per month.

facts: My favorite brand of soy sauce is Kikkoman.
I dropped out of high school.
My favorite film is Finding Nemo (2003).
I know the first 120 digits of pi.
I can say I don't speak a language in numerous languages.
I own five interchangeable sets of black clothes.
My favorite data structure is the hash table.
I held a school record in rope climbing for three years.
I once ate Chipotle for two straight weeks.
I once solved a Rubik's Cube in 42 seconds.
I can throw a disc 50 meters.
I have a mild obsession with bread.
